name: Solana de Rioalmar (Spain)
description: A red hoist third bearing three yellow towers in pale, the fly yellow with a blue horizontal stripe through the centre.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 21 February 2005 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 91 of 13 May 2005); the flag is of proportions 2:3, tierced at the hoist in red with three yellow towers, the fly yellow with a horizontal blue stripe.

features.role: central blue stripe on the yellow fly
